.tool-rail::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.property-card { overflow: hidden; }
.inspector-section, .inspector-head, .inspector-tabs, .property-card, .subpanel { min-width: 0px; }

.workspace-switch { height: 26px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(54px, 1fr)); align-items: stretch; padding: 1px; border: 1px solid rgb(32, 33, 35); background: rgb(43, 44, 46); border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035) 0px 1px inset; }

.workspace-switch button { min-height: 0px; height: 22px; padding: 0px 7px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; border-radius: 1px; color: rgb(174, 176, 179); font-size: var(--ui-type-xs); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; white-space: nowrap; }
.workspace-switch button svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
.workspace-switch button:hover { background: rgb(65, 66, 68); color: rgb(241, 242, 243); }
.workspace-switch button.active { background: rgb(37, 80, 76); color: rgb(131, 209, 201); box-shadow: rgb(67, 142, 135) 0px 0px 0px 1px inset; }
.application-menu { position: relative; height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: stretch; }
.application-menu-separator { display: block; height: 1px; margin: 4px 5px; }
.contextual-options > .workspace-switch { flex: 0 0 auto; margin-inline-start: auto; }
.property-card { margin: var(--ui-group-gap) 0; padding: 0px; border: 0px; border-radius: 0px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-ui-text); box-shadow: none; }
.app ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: var(--ui-scrollbar-width); height: var(--ui-scrollbar-width); }
.app ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { border: 2px solid var(--ui-scrollbar-track); border-radius: 0px; background: var(--ink-ui-scrollbar-thumb); }
.app ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { border-radius: 0px; background: var(--ui-scrollbar-track); }
.app ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--ink-ui-text-disabled); }
.application-menus > button, .application-menu > button, .application-menu-label, .application-command-menu button, .doc-title { font-size: var(--ui-type-lg); line-height: var(--ui-line-control); }
.application-menus > button, .application-menu > button, .application-menu-label, .application-command-menu button { font-weight: var(--ui-weight-regular); }

.quiet-button, .primary-button, .workspace-switch button, .contextual-tool-identity strong, .context-control-label, .contextual-options .quick-slider output, .selection-bar button, .panel-window-item, .inspector-tab, .properties-subnav .inspector-tab, .preset-button, .statusbar button, .creative-workspace-toggle, .ai-settings-grid label, .ai-preview-toolbar button, .creative-chat-runtime button, .mobile-dock .tool-label, .dock-action .tool-label, .tool-button .tool-label, .creative-workspace-tabs button, #canvasSettings .control-row, #canvasSettings .control-row > span:first-child, #canvasSettings .toggle-row, .inspector-section .control-row, .inspector-section .toggle-row { font-size: var(--ui-type-md); line-height: var(--ui-line-control); }
.shell-property-card { margin-top: 0px; }
